title: Kissed Syrian Lamb Stew
description: A savory midnight-craving lamb stew packed with aromatic herbs and a velvety vin santo reduction, served over hearty root vegetables for a paleo-friendly comfort dish.

ingredients.name: dried herbs
ingredients.amount: oregano 1 tsp, cumin 1 tsp, bay leaf 2

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for one minute.
Add the cubed lamb and brown all sides.
Mix in the tomato paste, dried herbs, and chopped apricots, stirring to coat.
Pour in the low sodium broth and bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the sliced carrots and celery, simmer for an additional 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove the pot from heat, stir in chopped parsley, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, spooning the stew into bowls and drizzling with a splash of vin santo if desired.
Garnish with extra parsley and enjoy the rich, aromatic flavors.
